slug: 2024-08-19 Libya implements biometric voter verification in municipal council elections

systems.tiers: Election centres in four municipalities at first: Zliten, Al-Sbiaa, Brak and Al-Abrak, during voter-card distribution for the municipal council elections, August 2024

note: A national electoral commission's biometric voter verification used in municipal council elections; not a system or connection of the municipal offices.
